Hypertension.Conditions: Heart failure with preserved systolic function; Malignant hypertension/acute pulmonary oedema
Hypertension.Investigations: 24 h ambulatory BP; Plasma metanephrines, renal artery imaging; Renin and aldosterone

Valve disease.Conditions: Primary valve disease e.g., aortic stenosis; Secondary valve disease e.g., functional regurgitation; Congenital valve disease

Arrhythmias.Investigations: Ambulatory ECG recording; Electrophysiology study, if indicated

CMPs.Conditions: All (Dilated, Hypertrophic, Restrictive); ARVC; Peripartum; Takotsubo syndrome; Toxins: alcohol, cocaine, iron, copper
CMPs.Investigations: CMR; genetic testing; Right and left heart catheterization; CMR, angiography; Trace elements, toxicology; LFTs, GGT

Congenital heart disease.Conditions: Congenitally corrected/repaired transposition of great arteries; Shunt lesions; Repaired tetralogy of Fallot; Ebstein's anomaly

Infective.Conditions: Viral myocarditis; Chagas disease; HIV; Lyme disease

Drug-induced.Conditions: Anthracyclines; Trastuzumab; VEGF inhibitors; Immune checkpoint inhibitors; Proteasome inhibitors; RAF+MEK inhibitors

Infiltrative.Investigations: Serum electrophoresis and serum free light chains; Bence Jones protein; Bone scintigraphy; CMR; CT-PET; EMB; Serum ACE; FDG-PET; Chest CT

Storage disorders.Conditions: Haemochromatosis; Fabry disease; Glycogen storage diseases
Storage disorders.Investigations: Iron studies; genetics; CMR (T2* imaging); EMB; α-galactosidase A testing; genetics; CMR (T1 mapping)

Pericardial disease.Investigations: Chest CT; CMR; Right and left heart catheterisation

Metabolic.Conditions: Endocrine disease; Nutritional disease (thiamine, vitamin B1 and selenium deficiencies); Autoimmune disease
Metabolic.Investigations: TFTs; plasma metanephrines; renin and aldosterone; cortisol; Specific plasma nutrients; ANA, ANCA; rheumatology review
